title: fix(metadata)!: remove metadata by (package, name), and refuse a package-less removal of a name two packages hold (ADR-0150 D3/D4)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB73EY28oYB7DooFBsYXzY8o)_

Fixes #32198

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` teaches neither `unregister` nor `unregisterPackage` (grep: none); `content/docs/kernel/contracts/metadata-service.mdx` excerpts the spec `IMetadataService`, whose signatures this change does not touch.

Narrowing: in-process answers of `@objectstack/metadata`'s `MetadataManager` removal methods, no HTTP or MCP door. "A type stored per package" is a member of `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES` (today `api`, `agent`, `skill`).
1. `unregister(type, name)` naming no package, for a name two packages hold, of a type stored per package: FROM every package's item and the name's stored row removed TO `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` (`PackageScopedNameRefusedError`, `ambiguous-in-environment`) naming every holder, nothing removed or announced. Fix: `unregister(type, name, { packageId })` or `unregisterPackage(packageId)`. First-party production call sites on such a type: 0.
2. `unregisterPackage(P)`: FROM leaving every item that carries only the `_packageId` stamp (the artifact door's items) TO removing them, for every type; for a type stored per package only P's item of each name. Fix: none for a caller that meant to remove the package. First-party production callers: 0.
3. Removing P's item of a type stored per package from a writable `datasource:` loader: FROM the name's row deleted whichever package's item it held TO deleted only when it holds P's item (`DatabaseLoader`). Fix: none; remove each package's item to remove every one. First-party production boots wiring a `DatabaseLoader`: 0.
4. Realtime `metadata.<type>.deleted` for one package's removal of a type stored per package: FROM no package TO `packageId` (a field `MetadataEventSchema` already declares); only `agent` has such an event type today, so a `subscribeMetadata('agent', …, { packageId: P })` subscription now receives it. Fix: none. First-party `subscribeMetadata` callers: 0.
5. `MetadataLoader.delete?(type, name, options?)`: optional `options.packageId`; a loader that ignores it deletes by name and compiles unchanged.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：按 (package, name) 移除元数据。`unregisterPackage` 现在也认制品入口打上的 `_packageId`；对按包分槽存储的类型（`api`、`agent`、`skill`），移除一个包的项只删该包的槽、只删属于该包的存储行，实时 `deleted` 事件带上该包；`unregister(type, name)` 不指明包而该名有两个包持有时，拒绝 409，什么都不删。
- 为什么改：ADR-0150 D3/D4。之前删一个包的项会连带删掉另一个包的存储行，不带包的 `unregister` 会把所有包的同名项一起删掉，而制品入口注册的项 `unregisterPackage` 根本删不掉。
- 风险与回滚：只动 `@objectstack/metadata` 的进程内移除方法；不在分槽集合里的类型、只有一个持有者的名字、观察者事件都不变。生产代码里这些移除方法在分槽类型上的调用点为 0。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata/src/package-slotted-store.ts` 的 `storeRemovalKeys`，`packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts` 的 `unregisterAt` / `unregisterPackage`，`packages/metadata/src/loaders/database-loader.ts` 的 `delete`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/metadata-manager-match-endpoint.test.ts src/loaders/database-loader.test.ts`，预期 165 个用例全部通过，新钉子遍历 `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES` 的每个成员。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`unregisterPackage(P)`** selects an item as P's when it carries `packageId`, `package` or the registry's `_packageId` stamp (`isPackageMember`, shared with the package publish/revert collector). The artifact door stamps only `_packageId`, so its items were never removed before. For a type stored per package each selected slot is removed by its own key, with P as the storage package.
- **One rule for what a removal takes** (`storeRemovalKeys`, beside the write and read rules in `package-slotted-store.ts`), judged before storage is touched:
  - naming a package: that package's slot only, never another package's item and never the name's bare slot;
  - naming none: every slot of the name while at most one package holds it, as before; with two or more holders, `PackageScopedNameRefusedError` (`409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, `ambiguous-in-environment`, candidates every holder). It refuses even where a bare read would resolve a unique non-baseline holder, because a removal acts on what it names.
  - a type outside the set: the name's key, whatever package is named, as before.
- **`MetadataManager.unregister(type, name, options?)`** takes a class-level `options.packageId` (`MetadataUnregisterOptions extends MetadataWriteOptions`), the way `get` takes a class-level package argument. Spec `MetadataWriteOptions` is untouched. `bulkUnregister` reports a refusal in that item's `errors`.
- **Storage half.** `MetadataLoader.delete` takes optional `MetadataLoaderDeleteOptions` `{ packageId }`, passed only for a type stored per package removed by one package; every other delete call is byte-identical to before (no third argument). `DatabaseLoader.delete` keeps the row unless it holds that package's item: its `package_id` column when filled, else the stored body's `packageId` or `_packageId` (`storedItemPackageId`). A row it cannot attribute (a package-less customization, D4) is kept.
- **Events.** The realtime `deleted` event carries the removed package as `packageId` for such a removal. The watcher event is unchanged.

## Tests

- `packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager-match-endpoint.test.ts`, new top-level describe "removal by (package, name) for every type stored per package", iterating `[...PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES]` (never a restated list). The boot is the artifact door's shape: door `MemoryLoader` saved and registered `{ notify: false }`, items carrying only `_packageId`, a `DatabaseLoader` on an in-memory driver as the writable `datasource:` loader, a realtime stub and a watcher. Per type:
  - `unregisterPackage` removes each package's item from its own slot and keeps the other's, in both orders (BASE: removed nothing);
  - the storage half keeps the row holding the other package's body and deletes it with its own package (BASE: removing alpha deleted beta's row);
  - the realtime `deleted` names the package where the type has a realtime event, nothing is published where it has none, and the watcher event names the item only;
  - `unregister(type, name)` on two holders is refused with code, status, reason and both candidates, and removes and announces nothing (BASE: both slots and the row went);
  - `unregister(type, name, { packageId })` removes that slot and only its row, and names the package;
  - CONTROL one holder: a package-less removal is unchanged;
  - the door `MemoryLoader` residue, pinned as today's state (#32246 flips it).
  - CONTROL a type outside the set (`view`): removal by name whatever package is named, no package on the event; `unregisterPackage` newly removes its `_packageId`-only item.
- The #32151 describe's `_packageId` non-removal pin is flipped to removal, for `agent` and `skill`.
- `packages/metadata/src/loaders/database-loader.test.ts`, new describe "delete scoped to one package": keep/delete by `_packageId`, by a stored envelope's `packageId`, keep an unattributable row, CONTROL delete by name with no package.

## Acceptance notes

- **Residue carried to #32246** (seat 3 ruling Q2): the artifact door's in-memory loader (`memory:`) is never deleted from, and it keeps one item per name, the body registered last. So once every package's item of a name is removed on an artifact-door boot, `list`, a bare `get`, `exists` and `get(type, name, P)` are still served that body, the read naming a removed package included. This is true on `main` for every type. The pin "once every slot of the name is removed, the door's in-memory loader still serves the body registered last" holds it as today's state, and its comment says #32246 flips it. This PR's TO for limb 1 is therefore true for the registry and the writable loaders, not for reads on an artifact-door boot after the last slot of a name goes.
- **Write side carried to #32246** (seat 3 ruling Q1=A): `DatabaseLoader.save` keys rows by `(type, name)` and writes no `package_id`, so two packages' items of one name share one row holding the last writer's body. This PR deletes only a row that holds the removing package's item; the one-row-per-name write side is #32246's.
- **Watcher event unchanged** (ruling Q3): spec `MetadataWatchEventSchema` declares no package field, so `subscribe(type, …)` still receives `deleted` with the name only. In-tree watchers on these types are the endpoint matcher (invalidates its whole index) and the HMR stream (forwards the name).
- **Census row owed by #32162** (seat-noted): plugin-security `dropEcho` calls a bare `unregister('permission' | 'position', name)`. It reaches this refusal once `permission` joins `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES`.
- Side observation, no action here: the realtime `created` / `updated` events from `register` read `data.packageId` only, so an artifact-door item's event names no package.

## Verification

All at `9e2a4a916f` (on `origin/main` `0eca80a7`; `main` has since moved 18 commits, none under `packages/metadata`), under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`.

<details><summary>Suites and typecheck</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata test`: Test Files 71 passed (71); Tests 1041 passed (1041). Exit 0.
- The two pinned files: 165 passed.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation</summary>

Fix committed first (`bc829c83`); each mutation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` against the two pinned files (165 cases, at `bc829c83`), then restored with the blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty:

- A, `isPackageMember` without `_packageId`: 15 red (every type's `unregisterPackage`, storage, realtime and residue pins, the flipped #32151 pins, the non-slotted `unregisterPackage` CONTROL), 150 green.
- B, `DatabaseLoader.delete` without the package filter: 9 red (the two storage pins per type, the three `DatabaseLoader` keep pins), 156 green.
- C, the two-holder refusal removed: 3 red (the refusal pin per type), 162 green.
- D, a removal naming a package dropping every slot of the name: 3 red (the `{ packageId }` pin per type), 162 green.
- E, no `packageId` on the realtime `deleted`: 2 red (`agent`'s realtime pins; `api` and `skill` have no realtime event type), 163 green.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 65 families for this diff, run serially at this head after a full `pnpm build` (119/119 tasks). 65 run, each exit 0; `--ran` reconciles 65 derived, 65 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.

- The first round, at `bc829c83`, found two reds, both on the new pins' in-memory row driver: `check:objectql-double-limit` (its `find` ignored `limit`) and `check:where-matcher` (its matcher read a combinator as a field name). `9e2a4a91` makes the driver conjoin equality and `$in`, refuse any other operator or combinator, and apply `limit` after the filter and before copying rows; both gates then exit 0.
- `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed its pinned fixture commit fetched; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:lean-entry-closure` needed the full build; `check:type-check-debt` was re-run under the lock after the dogfood run released it. Each then exit 0.
- `pnpm lint`, `test:repo` and the rest of the farm are CI's.

</details>

<details><summary>Dogfood</summary>

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` at this head after the full build, under the lock: Test Files 447 passed, 3 skipped (450); Tests 3726 passed, 42 skipped (3768). `VERDICT command-exit 0`. No failure.

</details>
